tada.config.title: TADA Settings
tada.config.checkIntervalTicks.desc: How often the worn armor is checked and the effects are refreshed. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default 100 (5 s). Lower values react faster but cost a little more server time.
tada.config.effectDurationTicks.desc: How long each applied effect lasts. Default 320 (16 s). Minecraft blinks the HUD icon and flickers Night Vision when 200 ticks or less remain, so values below check interval + 201 are raised automatically on save.
tada.config.strengthLevelsPerPiece.desc: Strength levels added by each piece with a Strength trim (Bolt, Silence). Default 2: one piece gives Strength II, four pieces Strength VIII.
tada.config.strengthMaxLevel.desc: Upper limit for the stacked Strength level. Default 8 (Strength VIII). Maximum 255.
tada.config.onlyTadaArmor.desc: No: any trimmed armor (diamond, netherite, modded) gives the trim ability. Yes: only TADA obsidian armor does. Default No.
tada.config.goldTrimCountsForPiglins.des: Yes: a piece with a gold trim counts as golden armor, so piglins stay peaceful. Default Yes.
tada.config.reset.desc: Set this value back to its default (%s). Applied when you press Done.
